metrics.name: Beats and density (T0 runs of roam, smart, smart+P, focus, dash, evolve)
metrics.value: beats off-rule 0; alive max 534; over row maxAlive 84 (row of the minute: 311); saturated share max 0.292
metrics.target: beats on time or per deferral; alive <= row.maxAlive + 160 (inside a cage, the row in force when it rose) and <= 610; saturated share <= 0.25

metrics.name: Density band (smart+P median free-field alive per minute vs the A7.2 Target alive; free field = steps with no cage and no lull)
metrics.value: hive 9/9 (minute mean 5/9), depths 9/9 (minute mean 6/9), wastes 9/9 (minute mean 5/9)
metrics.target: in band in 3 of 4 scored minutes (7 of 9; the cage rows 4, 7 and 11 have no band)

metrics.name: Win rate (30 seeds per world)
metrics.value: hive smart+P 18/30, smart 7/30; depths smart+P 13/30, smart 3/30; wastes smart+P 16/30, smart 5/30

metrics.name: Median survival (a win or a stalemate counts as the whole 14:00)
metrics.value: hive smart 14:00, smart+P 14:00, crude 2:09; depths smart 7:09, smart+P 9:29, crude 2:11; wastes smart 12:04, smart+P 14:00, crude 1:44
metrics.target: smart >= 5:30; smart+P >= 8:00; crude >= 2:30; Hive crude >= Depths and Wastes

metrics.name: Level curve (smart+P median level; a run that won earlier counts its final level)
metrics.value: hive L9/L20/L25 at 3:00/8:00/11:00, gap over 60 s in 21/30 runs; depths L11/L20.5/L24 at 3:00/8:00/11:00, gap over 60 s in 9/30 runs; wastes L11/L20.5/L26.5 at 3:00/8:00/11:00, gap over 60 s in 9/30 runs
metrics.target: L9 to 12 at 3:00; L18 to 23 at 8:00; L23 to 28 at 11:00; no gap over 60 s after 1:00

metrics.name: Build systems (dash = smart+dash+P vs smart+P mean survival; fusion over priority runs that reach 4:00; evolve runs that reach mid2; XP = roam, up to the PRIME kill)
metrics.value: hive dash 1.13x, cc 1.67/min, fusion by 4:00 65/86, evolve 22/28, XP min 0.933 (whole run 0.933); depths dash 1.27x, cc 1.41/min, fusion by 4:00 73/90, evolve 16/20, XP min 0.892 (whole run 0.849); wastes dash 1.24x, cc 2.3/min, fusion by 4:00 73/86, evolve 23/27, XP min 0.885 (whole run 0.891)
metrics.target: dash >= 1.25x; 1 to 4 close calls/min; >= 50% fusion by 4:00; >= 40% evolve; XP >= 90%
